name: slack-notion-thread-sync-sweep

deploy.description: Daily sweep behind the Slack <-> Notion thread sync. For each active thread_map row: (1) resolve check — if the discussion no longer appears in GET /v1/comments the thread is marked resolved and a closing note is posted to Slack (resolved and deleted are indistinguishable via the API); (2) reply backstop — diffs the full Slack thread against message_map and mirrors anything the event-driven durable missed, making the mirror self-healing. Idempotent: both paths converge on the same slack_ts-keyed rows.
